name: carried_context
description: A piece of context the programme must keep across sessions — a ruling not to relitigate, a constraint, a trap already paid for.

aiGuidance.purpose: The programme's memory. Each record holds one thing a later worker would otherwise rediscover the hard way: a settled ruling, a standing constraint, a trap that has already cost time. The rationale is the load-bearing part — it is what stops the question being reopened.
aiGuidance.extraction: Create one wherever the source says a matter is settled, warns against a path, or records a constraint that outlives the unit that produced it. Put the standing statement in summary and the reasoning — including what would have to change to reopen it — in rationale.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Not a general note store. If the item is only true for one unit, it belongs on that unit, not here.
